estimates.assumptions: Mascarpone is a soft cheese; standard nutritional data for full-fat mascarpone is ~429 kcal/100 g. The 250 g measurement is taken directly as the edible mass.

Pistachio paste is a concentrated product of ground pistachios (often with a small amount of oil/sugar). Typical calorie density for commercial pistachio paste is 550-580 kcal/100 g; 550 used here as a realistic midpoint. The 100 g measurement is taken directly as the edible mass.

One average unwaxed lime weighs ~100-120 g whole; only the zest is used in the recipe, which is ~5-10 g of edible zest. However, the supplied knownCaloriesPer100g=30 matches the value for whole lime (edible portion). To reconcile, 50 g is used as a modest whole-lime edible-portion estimate (accounting for zest + any incidental juice). The supplied knownCaloriesPer100g=30 is copied exactly.
